question: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, now known as Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, was first enacted in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2005.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act** was first enacted in the year **2005.**
 
• The Act is a **social security scheme **that provides a legal guarantee for **100 days of employment** in a financial year to adult members of rural households who are willing to do unskilled manual work.
 
• The Act aims to address the issues of** poverty and unemployment** in rural India by providing a source of livelihood to the rural poor and strengthening the rural economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A** third of the employment** made available under the MGNREGA are guaranteed to** women.**
 
• It is worth noting that the idea of a **rural employment **guarantee was first proposed in the **1990s** by the National Commission on Rural Labour, which recommended a minimum of **100 days of employment** for rural households.
 
• It is worth noting that the Act has undergone several amendments since its enactment in** 2005,** including the inclusion of women as a separate category of workers in** 2008 **and the introduction of a provision for unemployment allowance in** 2013.**
